summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and thin ignite adapters for the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard handlers, per the spec. Also updated the three in-repo callers (output_path to output_dir), added tests for the new modules and handlers, and added docs entries for the two data modules. Nothing was run: no tests, no flake8, no installs. Lint-style checks (line length, trailing whitespace, final newline, unused imports) were done by reading only. Nothing is committed. Behavior change to note: CSV rows now follow insertion order instead of sorted order.
